ZOHO_CLIENT_ID.description: The consumer key of a connected application. Zoho states nothing about this half.

ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The consumer secret. Zoho is explicit about the token these buy: do not expose an access token in public forums, public repositories, or client-side HTML or JavaScript.

ZOHO_API_DOMAIN.description: Which data centre answers, learned once from the sign-in response. Shared by every tenant in that region rather than unique to you, unlike Salesforce's host. An address.
